data_objects.name: country_year_indicators
data_objects.meaning: Repeated country-year observations of population, life expectancy, GDP per capita, and continent membership.
data_objects.notes: Country labels are lowercase text and continent is a categorical geographic grouping.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Calendar year of the country observation.

variables.name: pop
variables.meaning: Population associated with the country and year.

variables.name: lifeexp
variables.meaning: Life expectancy associated with the country and year.

variables.name: gdppercap
variables.meaning: Gross domestic product per capita associated with the country and year.

variables.name: country
variables.meaning: Country name used as the longitudinal entity label.

variables.name: continent
variables.meaning: Continent category assigned to the country.

structure.description: Each row is a country-year observation; country plus year acts as the candidate key and countries have repeated observations over time.
country is the entity axis, year is the temporal axis, and continent is a higher-level grouping of countries.

uncertainties: The GDP currency, price year, purchasing-power treatment, and nominal-versus-real basis are not specified.
Population reference dates, life-expectancy methodology, and historical country-boundary conventions are not provided.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
